title: Rigidity and volume pinching for the sharp gradient estimate in positive Ricci curvature
summary: Colding established a sharp gradient estimate for the Green function on manifolds with non-negative Ricci curvature, which was extended to positive Ricci curvature by Manea recently. We prove almost rigidity of such gradient estimates for positive Ricci curvature. We show that the average of the gradient deficit, namely $\fint (1-|\nabla b|^2)\,dV$, controls the volume deficit in an optimal quantitative manner; here $b$ is the distance-like function defined using the Green function.
